review.recipe: Wide ivory teacup/saucer with clear pale honey-gold hot Irish whiskey toddy, nothing floating in liquid. Two removed spent thyme sprigs on saucer. Restrained steam. No lemon, brandy, foam or ice.
review.personality: Hastily set-down olive coat on pulled-up chair, face-down phone and keyring imply returning after being first to act, then accepting an offered seat. Coat survives narrow phone crop; phone/keys are peripheral and need export visual check.
review.world: Dark walnut surface, warm intimate reading-room, burgundy/olive/cream. No industrial metal; keyring is normal functional metal. v2 pulled camera back to avoid oversized saucer crop.
